inlines.v: HURT'LE, verb intransitive [from hurt.] To clash or run against; to jostle; to skirmish; to meet in shock and encounter; to wheel suddenly. [Not now used.] HURT'LE, verb transitive To move with violence or impetuosity. 1. To push forcibly; to whirl.
